scripts.server-directory:preview: npm run server-directory:build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.server-directory.local.jsonc --local --test-scheduled --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8787
scripts.editor:preview: node scripts/build-site.mjs editor --preview && wrangler dev --config wrangler.editor.local.jsonc --env-file worker/empty.env --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8788
scripts.editor:preview:production: node scripts/build-site.mjs editor --preview-production && wrangler dev --config wrangler.editor.local.jsonc --env-file worker/empty.env --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8788
scripts.editor:catalog:regenerate: npm run editor:schema:sync && npm run editor:runtime:sync && npm run editor:language:sync && npm run editor:addons:sync && npm run editor:schema:full
scripts.editor:worker:types: wrangler types worker/config-editor/bindings.production.d.ts --env-interface EditorProductionEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.editor.jsonc && wrangler types worker/config-editor/bindings.local.d.ts --env-interface EditorLocalEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.editor.local.jsonc
scripts.editor:worker:types:check: wrangler types worker/config-editor/bindings.production.d.ts --env-interface EditorProductionEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.editor.jsonc --check && wrangler types worker/config-editor/bindings.local.d.ts --env-interface EditorLocalEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.editor.local.jsonc --check
scripts.worker:setup:local: npm run worker:migrate:local && npm run worker:seed:local
scripts.worker:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.server-directory.local.jsonc --local
scripts.worker:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.server-directory.jsonc --remote
scripts.worker:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.server-directory.local.jsonc --local --file worker/seeds/local-server-directory.sql
scripts.worker:deploy:check: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run && npm run server-directory:deploy:check
scripts.worker:types: wrangler types worker/bindings.production.d.ts --env-interface ProductionEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types worker/server-directory/bindings.production.d.ts --env-interface ServerDirectoryProductionEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.server-directory.jsonc && wrangler types worker/server-directory/bindings.local.d.ts --env-interface ServerDirectoryLocalEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.server-directory.local.jsonc
scripts.worker:types:check: wrangler types worker/bindings.production.d.ts --env-interface ProductionEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.jsonc --check && wrangler types worker/server-directory/bindings.production.d.ts --env-interface ServerDirectoryProductionEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.server-directory.jsonc --check && wrangler types worker/server-directory/bindings.local.d.ts --env-interface ServerDirectoryLocalEnv --include-runtime=false --env-file worker/empty.env --config wrangler.server-directory.local.jsonc --check
scripts.worker:typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p worker/server-directory/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.test.json
